records.label: Car, BEV
records.comparison_grain: One legacy fixed-range representative paired with new merged archetype; same class, powertrain and 2020 vintage
records.legacy_notes: [bpkm/PJ] Vehicle class fuel efficiency aggregated from NRCan Fuel Economy Guide ratings by size class; BEV ratings were grouped into range classes, 150-mile range class values were used. Aggregation was done with Wards 2022 national size-class shares derived from vehicle sales by model in 2021. Values were harmonized using provincial load factors.
